news.title: ‘FBI, open!’ Man impersonates agent, threatens to kill hotel guest, police say
news.summary: A man is accused of impersonating a federal agent, threatening and attempting to kill a hotel guest in metro Atlanta.

news.title: Man accused of groping women at Panera Bread, Target and TJ Maxx in 10-minute span
news.summary: A man faces sexual battery charges after police say he groped at least three women at a Panera Bread, Target and TJ Maxx in Cobb County.

news.title: FOUND: Woman with autism missing from Atlantic Station located
news.summary: The family notified FOX 5 Atlanta on Tuesday morning that Jatalya Carroll has been found and is safe. No other information has been provided at this time.

news.title: Man arrested after shots fired near Chicago federal building, police say
news.summary: A man is in custody after police say he fired a gun near a downtown Chicago federal building.

news.title: Henry County detention officer arrested on multiple felony charges involving allegations of misconduct
Man gropes women across three stores in 10 minutes, police say
news.summary: A 35-year-old man faces sexual battery charges after allegedly groping three women across multiple stores in Austell.

news.title: Fourth suspect charged as Austell railyard murder investigation expands
news.summary: Investigators obtained an arrest warrant charging 36-year-old Christopher S. Riles.

news.title: Midnight shooting ends in Salem Road McDonald's drive-thru arrest
news.summary: A Newton County woman suffered multiple gunshot wounds in a Covington drive-thru Oct. 17.

news.title: Fourth suspect in shooting of Norfolk Southern contractor near railway property charged
news.summary: Christopher S. Riles faces felony murder and aggravated assault charges, Cobb County Police said.

news.title: Henry County detention officer arrested on multiple felony charges
news.summary: Detention Officer Kwamir Jamal Duncan faces four felony charges following an internal investigation.

news.title: Atlanta teen survives second apartment shooting in less than a year
news.summary: A 13-year-old boy is recovering after an Atlanta apartment shooting off Hank Aaron Drive sent bullets into his bed early Sunday.

news.title: Covington man charged after wife found shot at McDonald’s drive-thru
news.summary: Deputies responded to the restaurant about 1 a.m. Oct. 17 and found Davienne Trejo, 26, of Lakeland, Florida, wounded.

news.title: Student dead, another wounded in shooting at Atlanta Technical College
news.summary: Atlanta police responded around 8:45 a.m. on Oct. 19 to a report of a person shot at 1560 Metropolitan Parkway SW.

news.title: Student dies after allegedly shooting another student at Atlanta college
news.summary: One student died and another was hospitalized following a shooting Monday morning at Atlanta Technical College, according to the Atlanta Police Department.
